nyo-chat.summary: Nyo is the operator chat at the hub of cmd.nyyon.com. Loop: POST /api/chat -> handleChat (workers/api/src/chat/index.js, single 483-line file) streams SSE (start/delta/tool_call/tool_result/error/done) and runs up to 8 non-streaming provider hops, looping on stop_reason=tool_use. Built-in guards: per-turn tool dedup cache, a claim-vs-action guard (CLAIM_RE + read-only-prefix heuristic forces one correction hop if the model claims work no mutating tool did), 35s tool timeout (150s + 20s SSE keep-alive pings for 13 named SLOW_TOOLS), 60s LLM hop (120s local). Turns persist to conversations/messages; agent='daily-planner' swaps the system prompt to the daily-planner-persona knowledge doc and strips 9 calendar/task tools (PLANNER_DENY_TOOLS). Model tiers (resolveTier, sent per message, flippable mid-conversation): low = local Qwen via OLLAMA_BASE_URL tunnel with a lean LOW_SYSTEM + fixed 15-tool allow-list; mid = claude-sonnet-5; high = claude-opus-4-8; each model resolves llm-models knowledge doc > NYO_MODEL_* env > default (lib/model-config.js). A credit circuit-breaker (lib/llm.js + llm_health) classifies 400-credit/401/402/403, alerts once via nyo_messages, and falls back mid-turn to the low tier; provider transport lives only in lib/openai.js (llmTransportAnthropic / llmTransportOpenAICompat), with callOpenAI translating shapes so the loop always sees Anthropic format. Tool pool: tools/index.js statically imports 36 per-module files into one TOOL_REGISTRY of 246 tools (prompt's ~130 is stale), filtered by tool.<name> feature flags; Anthropic tiers get the server-side regex tool-search tool + 4 HOT_TOOLS up front with everything else defer_loading:true; Low gets only LOW_TOOLS.
